description: This is a makefile used for configuring, preparing, and building the glibc package within a build system for OpenWrt. It contains variables, build rules, and configuration commands specific to the glibc cross-compilation process.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain information such as LIBC_TYPE, LIBC_URL, LIBC_VERSION, and LIBC_SO_VERSION in the info.mk file.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates the build directory, runs the GLIBC configuration script with specified options.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build directory by creating necessary links and calling default preparation routines.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build directories and cleaning files related to the glibc build process.
